standing_decisions.question: How should Spring instantiate AlertService when the service exposes multiple constructors and no constructor is explicitly annotated?

considered.choice: Configure the alertService bean definition to use constructor autowiring
considered.consequence: Spring selects a resolvable constructor without changing the service contract or adding a default constructor.
Would require inventing or manually constructing application dependencies and could leave the service improperly initialized.

standing_decisions.chosen: Set constructor autowiring on the existing alertService bean definition during bean-definition post-processing.
standing_decisions.rationale: The boot failure is caused by constructor selection, and constructor autowiring preserves the existing dependency graph and in-memory behavior.
standing_decisions.reversal_cost: Remove the constructor-wiring configuration once AlertService has an explicit Spring constructor declaration.
